a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate together until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. The storm risk is high, but if either of us grabs early, the other is left with nothing. I won't take before 8, and I'll tell you honestly if anything changes.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating this round as agreed. Once the reserve shows 8, we each take 4, no more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
